row.notes: The vehicle controller system (owns the per-car ControllerSet list at +0x30/+0x38). Primary vtable: slot 2 (+0x10) 0x143899750 resolves dependencies, slot 11 (+0x58) 0x14389bc50 builds all sets, slot 14 (+0x70) 0x14389c8f0 stops (thunk to .data1 0x1519de8a0), slot 24 (+0xc0) 0x143899f30 destroys all sets, slot 32 (+0x100) 0x14389a120 applies each car's active input record. A second base (sub-object at system+0x20, so its +0x10/+0x18 are the system's +0x30/+0x38, its vtable starts at 0x1458825d0 (slot 0 0x1438d2be0)) carries the recordable interface: 0x14389ce30 writes every set's flags and mode, 0x14389ceb0 reads them back, 0x14389d370 (Car_Physics_ResettleVehicles_Thunk) resettles human cars; those are the flashback frame hooks. The class has no .pdata entry for the AI/human update calls; see vt_Sess_AiController.
